description.value: The Cliff House Restaurant is a casual West Coast dining room inside Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, perched above the canyon on the site of the original 1889 Cliff House. It serves fresh local ingredients, Ocean Wise seafood, BC wines, and regional craft beer on tap, with a large summer patio and cozy historic interior. Access requires purchasing paid park admission, making it a destination experience rather than a quick cyclist stop.

address.value: 3735 Capilano Road, North Vancouver, BC V7R 4J1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and rich. The Cliff House Restaurant is confirmed open as a sit-down casual dining venue inside Capilano Suspension Bridge Park at 3735 Capilano Road, North Vancouver. A critical access barrier exists: the website explicitly states 'Cliff House Restaurant is located inside Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, which requires paid admission or Annual Pass use.' Bike parking, washrooms, and most amenities are not mentioned on the website; vegetarian options are confirmed from the published menu (Black Bean & Corn Burger, Hummus & Pita, salads, Rice Bowl).
concerns: Access requires paid admission to Capilano Suspension Bridge Park — cyclists cannot enter the restaurant without purchasing a park ticket, which may be a significant cost barrier.
OSM name is 'Cliffhouse Restaurant' (one word) but the website consistently spells it 'Cliff House Restaurant' (two words).
No address or phone in OSM tags; both sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by rich website content. The paid park admission barrier is notable but does not make it inaccessible to the public.
